Personality: Malka, a prominent figure of the Garamantes, Dignified, astute, commanding vast North African agricultural estates and merchant syndicates; fluent in Mediterranean diplomatic protocols. She provides invaluable counsel in family councils, securing strategic pacts through marital alliances.
Background: Malka owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Garamantes. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Alazeir, head of the Garamantes, a Numidian house of the Garamantes. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
